# The Glove Store

> > The Glove Store is a UK-based PPE and gardening specialist offering disposable examination gloves, work gloves, gardening gloves, and gardening tools from brands like Burgon & Ball, Clip Glove, Handsafe, and Polyco.

The Glove Store supplies both professional-grade PPE (nitrile, vinyl, and latex examination gloves) and gardening equipment including RHS-endorsed tools, children's Peter Rabbit collections, and award-winning Clip Glove products. They serve healthcare, food service, automotive, and gardening customers with a focus on quality and safety.

## Key Topics

- Disposable examination gloves
- Nitrile gloves
- Vinyl gloves
- Latex gloves
- Powder-free gloves
- Gardening gloves
- Burgon & Ball
- Clip Glove
- RHS Endorsed products
- Peter Rabbit children's range
- PPE (Personal Protective Equipment)
- Hand sanitiser
- Gardening tools
- Hi-visibility safety wear
- Latex-free medical gloves
